scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on exact Poisson embedding, Gamma-quantile hazard asymptotics, and conditional binomial mixing; 143 independent exact rational finite assertions; finite evidence does not prove the asymptotic theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform iid coupon sampling only; no convergence rate or moment limit claimed. The m=1 stopped singleton law predates this result, and historical priority of all marked-extremes consequences remains to be independently checked.
title: Geometric-to-exponential transition for minimally filled types at coupon completion
